technical_body.notes: Non-overlapping with 6 and 11 at 20 MHz. Overlapping at 40 MHz.
Highest US channel — 12 and 13 are EU/JP only; 14 is JP-only 802.11b at 2484 MHz.
DFS radar-avoidance mandatory. Radios must vacate on radar detection.
6 GHz mandates WPA3-Personal or WPA3-Enterprise; no WPA2 downgrade.
Highest US 6 GHz channel — 7115 MHz center. Above this is not FCC-allocated.
